response.sql: WITH source_stats AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS source_size, AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL AND s.boxz <> 0 THEN 1.0 * s.boxy / s.boxz END) AS avg_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(source_size) AS avg_source_size FROM source_stats) SELECT AVG(ss.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio, SUM(ss.source_size) AS combined_size, AVG(ss.source_size - o.avg_source_size) AS avg_size_excess FROM source_stats AS ss CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ss.source_size > o.avg_source_size;
